text:
Maya Chen: hi - customer accepted org invite an hour ago but when they switch to the project they get a 403 in the console and via API. says they used SSO -> okta. 
Jordan (CS): :wave: can you paste the exact error they see? any request id?
Maya Chen: here's what customer sent: `GET /v1/projects/abc123` -> 403 Forbidden, body: {\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"message\":\"user does not have project:view\"}. no request id in body, they attached screenshot of console UI showing \"Permission denied\".
Jordan (CS): thanks. did they accept using the same email that is mapped in Okta? sometimes invite email != idp primary.
Maya Chen: confirmed email matches. They can list org-level resources but projects show forbidden.
Priya (IDP): possible: OIDC claim used for roles (`roles` claim) got trimmed during a session refresh. we've seen `roles` drop if token size too large or attribute mapping changed. any recent idp config change?
Maya Chen: customer said IT rotated sessions earlier today. they also ran a group rename in Okta an hour before.
eng-oncall: looking at auth logs for that org - I see an auth success for the user at 1753212100, then a refresh at 1753214000 with a token that has fewer claims. forwarded relevant logs to this thread.
eng-oncall: logs snippet: ```
[1753214000] token-validate user=m.chen@acme.com claims=[sub, email, name] missing=[roles, project_ids]
[1753214012] access-check project=abc123 user=m.chen  -> DENIED code=403
```
Jordan (CS): OK that points to idp claim loss. workarounds?
Priya (IDP): temporary: have org-admin invite the user again and ensure SCIM sync pushes `roles` attribute. or manually add the user to the project via the console (Project Settings -> Access -> Add member) while we remediate idp mapping. also ask customer to fully sign out of SSO sessions (clear SSO session) then re-login to force fresh token.
Maya Chen: customer tried re-login, still 403. they haven't retried invite-add. they prefer not to have org-admin manually add. any backend fix?
eng-oncall: we can trigger a re-evaluate of idp attributes for that user from our side: run `POST /internal/idp/resync?user=...` (requires eng privileges). I'll file infra task and run it if approved.
Jordan (CS): please do that and capture request id. include the customer's org id so we can audit. also note to CS -> include exact project id and user email in escalation.
eng-oncall: filed infra ticket INF-1954 and ran resync at 1753215900. result: idp sync returned roles=[project:viewer:abc123] and project access granted.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: change detected: idp-resync INF-1954 completed by eng-oncall.
Maya Chen: customer confirms they can now access project and console shows editor view. :tada:
Priya (IDP): root cause summary to paste in ticket: idp session rotation + recent group rename caused SCIM/claim mapping to drop the `roles` claim during token refresh. result: tokens lacked project-level role claims -> 403 on project endpoints. mitigation: re-sync SCIM, re-invite if needed, or manual project add. long term: recommend adding fallback that checks org-level group memberships when `roles` claim missing and returning clearer error (include request id).
Jordan (CS): I'll update the support ticket and advise customer on steps to prevent (coordinate with Okta admin to avoid mid-session group renames during rotation). closing once customer confirms no further issues.
Maya Chen: confirmed, leaving ticket open for 24h then will close. thanks everyone. :heart:
